d: A new political alliance between Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad's Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) has added a new dimension to Uttar Pradesh politics ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. On Neta Nagari, we examine whether the Samajik Parivartan Morcha can challenge Akhilesh Yadav's PDA strategy and change the political equations in Western UP.

In this episode of LT Insider, Terence Lewis discusses his upcoming film Aaj Ka Mahishasur, his transition from dance to acting, and bringing the mythological figure of Mahishasur into today's context. He also opens up about his early struggles, his journey in the dance industry, and his experience facing the camera as an actor.

In this episode of Guest In The Newsroom, singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha speaks with Kuldeep Mishra about his musical journey and the stories behind iconic bhajans like "Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani," "Maiya Ka Chola Hai Rang Lal," and "Are Dwarpalo." The conversation also touches on Khalistan, Sidhu Moose Wala, Daler Mehndi, Gulshan Kumar, and his views on the changing music industry.

In this episode of Kitabwala, Kuldeep Mishra sits with engineer and author Krish Ashok to explore the science behind everyday food beliefs, decoding myths about ghee, refined flour, and rice. The conversation is based on Ashok's book Masala Body.

On this week's Neta Nagari, Lallantop Executive Editor Kuldeep Mishra discusses Sonia Gandhi's autobiography, Belonging: A Journey of Love, and the personal stories she has shared about the Gandhi family. The conversation explores her decision not to become Prime Minister in 2004, her relationship with Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, and the story behind the book's publication.

The Lallantop Show Episode 2134 examines India's rising inflation, Rahul Gandhi's phone-tapping allegations against PM Narendra Modi and Akhilesh Yadav's reaction. We also report on a major road accident in Assam's Kaziranga, where over 20 people are feared dead.

Duniyadari Episode 1760 examines the claims and controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, alleged Chinese espionage links and the company's reported leadership uncertainty. Plus, Microsoft's global outage, a fatal UAE road accident and a viral incident involving Pete Hegseth.
